text.p: Salomon Brothers revised upward its third-quarter and full-year earnings estimates for Tel Aviv-based Nice Systems after the company said earnings would exceed analysts' estimates.
Analyst Victor Halpert raised his earnings per share (EPS) estimate for the quarter to $0.21 from $0.18 and full-year EPS to $0.74 from $0.71.
Salomon also reiterated its strong-buy recommendation for Nice, a maker of digital voice- and fax-recording systems.

Nice said third-quarter earnings would be in the $0.21-0.23 range and revenues would likely reach $10 million to $10.5 million, nearly double the $5.41 million of a year earlier but lower than Salomon's estimate of $11.35 million.
European sales were slow in August, said Halpert, but gross and operating margins were higher, raising earnings.

Halpert said market studies and beta site testing for the company's Nicefax product were getting underway, with commercial sales due to begin in the fourth quarter. "We continue to believe that Nicefax presents the most exciting opportunity for the company's future," he said.
